# Blank PNG regression fixture

`barley-blank.png` is the 1536×2048 raster reported in [issue 88](https://github.com/keesey/phylopic/issues/88).
Its one-bit grayscale PNG uses a `tRNS` transparency chunk and has no visible pixels.

- Image: _Hordeum vulgare_ subsp. _vulgare_, by Michelle Stitzer, CC0.
- PhyloPic UUID: `c9d31948-819e-401a-abe5-8a4268421b96`.
- [Original download](https://images.phylopic.org/images/c9d31948-819e-401a-abe5-8a4268421b96/raster/1536x2048.png).

The remaining test images are generated locally by ImageMagick. Tests do not use the network or AWS.
